about: Poltergeist 2 ghost-machine: the SPYGLASS (spectrum + scope window) and the window size grip, painted by src/spyglass.py. Same conventions as ui.json (design px, PNGs at 2x, pivot in design px, slice = [left, top, right, bottom]).

assets.name: spyglass
assets.use: The SPYGLASS on the jib: a brass telescope clamped to the OUT gauge's pipe. Draw at the control's rect; the lit sprite over it with alpha = light level.

assets.name: spyglass-lit
assets.use: The SPYGLASS lit: the lens glows amber (hover, press, and while its window is open).

assets.name: size-grip
assets.use: Brass corner grip: drag it to make the plugin window bigger or smaller (right-click: sizes).

assets.name: spy-frame
assets.use: The SPYGLASS window: riveted iron frame with brass trim. 9-slice; the analyzer sits in the inner rect; the lee-bottom gusset is the resize grip.

assets.name: spy-title
assets.use: Title plate of the SPYGLASS window (3-slice along its length); its name is live text.

assets.name: spy-close
assets.use: Close cap of the SPYGLASS window.
